assignat-1790s.title: Assignat
assignat-1790s.extract: An assignat was a monetary instrument, an order to pay, used during the time of the French Revolution, and the French Revolutionary Wars.

continental-currency-1775.title: Early American currency
continental-currency-1775.extract: Early American currency went through several stages of development during the colonial and post-Revolutionary history of United States. John Hull was authorized by the Massachusetts legislature to make the earliest coinage of the colony in 1652.
